messages:
Ravi: flagging a billing irregularity from a customer: streaming session got truncated by router GC, a downstream toolcall still ran and was later replayed on reconnect. ledger shows two confirmed charges.
Nora: can you paste the minimal trace?
Ravi: excerpt (redacted):
```
router: gc_evicted session=cli-2 shard=3 seq=142 reason=kvcache_evict
stream: truncated session=cli-2 truncated=30
toolcall: outer_id=tc-77 status=success returned_tokens=22
client: reconnect session=cli-2b resume_from=140
toolcall: outer_id=tc-77 status=success returned_tokens=22 (replayed)
ledger: write confirmed tenant=acct-11 tokens=44
```
Priya: bottom line: we currently flip ledger->confirmed on toolcall_done event. for streaming with possible midstream GC that is unsafe.
Ethan: quick options: 1) make toolcall charges provisional until client commit/ack, 2) require router to attach canonical_commit_id to toolcall events and dedupe on ledger, 3) hybrid: provisional + commit_id dedupe.
Nora: hybrid seems safest. provisional prevents premature invoicing, commit_id dedupe handles idempotent replays that happen before commit.
Ravi: telemetry asks: new counters provisional_writes, provisional_reconciles, duplicate_toolcalls_detected. emit tenant-scoped rates and a low-cardinality tag for rollout flag state.
Priya: console change: in request trace UI show a compact timeline: [toolcall(provisional)] -> [commit_event(reconciled)] with hover text: "provisional: may be rolled back if stream truncated or replayed". also show reconcile latency.
Ethan: data model sketch: provisional_ledger (tenant, canonical_commit_id, toolcall_key, tokens, created_at) append-only. reconcile worker groups by canonical_commit_id and collapses duplicates then emits confirm. use TTL index (7d) for forgotten entries.
Nora: implementation caveat: many short-lived toolcalls could blow up writes. propose sampling: only provisionalize for sessions that match streaming=true and had a recent kv_eviction event. lowers overhead.
Ravi: rollouts: feature flag billing_provisional_v1. plan: enable for internal tenancies + 5% hosted, 100% dedicated. monitor provisional_to_confirmed ratio and reconcile latency.
Ethan: alerts: fire if duplicate_toolcalls_detected/total_toolcalls > 0.2% for 5m or reconcile_latency_p95>30s. metrics-bot pls add to default SRE alert playbook.
metrics-bot: alert created: billing.provisional.duplicate_rate > 0.2% (5m), reconcile.latency.p95 > 30s. linked to #eng-oncall.
Priya: API contract: router should attach commit_hint and canonical_toolcall_id to events. client should emit commit_ack when it has received stream suffix or end-of-response. docs needed for SDK teams.
Nora: can we do a quicker stopgap? maybe ledger ignores duplicate toolcall events within a sliding window when session ids differ but toolcall id matches. risk: could hide legitimate repeated toolcalls. prefer commit hint path.
Ravi: owners: Nora (ledger + reconcile worker), Priya (console + docs), Ethan (router events + feature flag), Ravi (RFC + rollout plan). I'll open RFC with sequence diagrams and a short failure-mode matrix.
Ethan: prototype note: will add a lightweight commit_hint header on toolcall events and mark writes provisional. will include canary flag.
Priya: UX note: show small orange pill "pending" on billed tokens until reconciled. allow ops to filter requests with pending > 0.
Ravi: repro steps to validate locally:
1) start router with kv_ttl=50ms
2) send a long streaming prompt (200 tokens) with toolcall at ~140
3) force router GC midstream
4) reconnect client to different router that will replay toolcall
Expect: single confirmed token invoice after reconcile. Current: two confirmed.
Ethan: will queue a branch and put canary on staging. deploy-bot: schedule?
deploy-bot: canary scheduled for branch r/provisional-ledger on staging-canary-1. Will report results in #eng-oncall.
Ravi: thanks everyone. adding follow-ups to RFC. please drop any additional edge cases in the doc.
